runs.content: Becton Dickinson is +36% in 3 months and held near its 6-month high through the AI-capex rout after an FQ4 beat (adj EPS +27%) and an FY27 adj EPS guide of $13.10–13.30 (~16x), a defensive non-tech medtech momentum entry; ICFI was exited as the capacity trim.

Pfizer beat Q3 and raised FY26 revenue and EPS guidance yet trades at ~10x forward with a 5.6% yield, a defensive Burry-aligned entry on an AI-capex rout (S&P −4.4%, VIX 28); NDAQ was trimmed for capacity at +1.16% and no stops or targets triggered.
